newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MIXED ON KEY CURRENCIES.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MIXED ON KEY CURRENCIES.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted softer on the key U.S. dollar and the rand but registered gains on European currencies at the close of Tuesday's interbank trading session, dealers said.

"We saw import pressure push the dollar as far as 11.4150/4250 and at that point the central (Reserve) bank must have come in (with support) because a number of banks were selling U.S. dollars towards the end," one dealer commented.
He said the local unit finished the day at 11.4050/4150 on the U.S. dollar from Monday's 11.3950/4050 and was also quoted weaker against South Africa's rand at 2.5200/5400 compared to 2.5135/5235.
It was however firmer on sterling at 18.9000/9300 compared to 18.9190/9690 and at 6.5300/5500 from 6.5350/5620 versus the mark.
